# Test fixtures

`lerengebaren-*.html` are pages from the old LerenGebaren.nl dictionary (`https://www.lerengebaren.nl/gebarenwoordenboek/<word>`), saved on 2026-11-14.
- The content is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 by LerenGebaren.nl.
- They are used only to test our HTML parser (`tests/runtime/`).

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `huis` | A word that exists |
| `afval` | A word that Signbank does not have |
| `zzqqxy` | The "Niet gevonden!" page |
